outlook.statement: Elevated fuel and energy prices may have an impact on operating costs. The resulting volatility may have implications for operating costs, business sentiment and demand for EPC business in the year 2026-27.

The Company will follow a measured and disciplined approach to rebuilding its business activities with immediate emphasis on strengthening the operating platform, effectively executing available projects, maintaining financial discipline and selectively pursuing new business opportunities aligned with established capabilities.
The immediate business outlook remains centred on strengthening the Company's operating base, improving execution efficiency and selectively rebuilding business activity across its core sectors.

The Company does not intend to pursue order growth at the cost of project quality or financial discipline. New opportunities will be considered in a measured manner, with preference for projects aligned with established engineering and execution capabilities.

The focus will now work as a partner to major expansions in the core sector for clients and hence the EPC outlook to minimize cost will be replaced by an outlook to add value with time saving and environment friendly solutions.
Efforts are already under way for scaling up the O&M business volume by 50% within the next financial year.
Hopefully, issue pertaining to Net Worth, Insolvency and Working Capital would be resolved at the earliest with the successful implementation of the Resolution Plan.
The Company has unabsorbed business losses available for set-off against future profits and the management expects improved business performance and profitability in the coming years.

The management has assessed the business plans, operational outlook, available financial resources and is of the view that the Company will be able to realise its assets and discharge its liabilities in the normal course of business. Accordingly, the Company has adequate resources to continue its operations for the foreseeable future and, therefore, the accompanying standalone financial statements have been prepared on a going concern basis.

The management has assessed the business plans, operational outlook, available financial resources and is of the view that the Group will be able to realise its assets and discharge its liabilities in the normal course of business. Accordingly, the Group has adequate resources to continue its operations for the foreseeable future and, therefore, the accompanying consolidated financial statements have been prepared on a going concern basis.
